l-e-h3-b03-04.goal: Ka bincika ko da'awar “taƙaitawa dole ta ƙunshi kowace jumla ta asali” gaskiya ce ko da yaushe, sannan ka nemo ka bayyana misalin da ba haka ba (misali mai karyatawa).
l-e-h3-b03-04.material: Da'awa: Taƙaitawa dole ta ƙunshi kowace jumla ta asali. Asali: “Gidan burodi yana buɗewa da ƙarfe shida. Ana sayar da burodinsa duka kafin ƙarfe tara, saboda haka masu shi yanzu suna toya kashi biyu. Af, sunan kyanwar shagon Biscuit ne.”
l-e-h3-b03-04.s.s1.o.a: Domin jumlar farko ce kawai take da muhimmanci.
l-e-h3-b03-04.s.s1.r.a: Jumla ta biyu ma muhimmiya ce.
l-e-h3-b03-04.s.s1.o.b: Domin jumlar sunan kyanwar ba ita ce babban saƙo ba, kuma ana iya barinta a taƙaitawa.
l-e-h3-b03-04.s.s1.o.c: Domin dukkan jimloli suna da muhimmanci iri ɗaya.
l-e-h3-b03-04.s.s1.r.c: Jimloli suna da matakan muhimmanci daban-daban.
l-e-h3-b03-04.s.s1.o.d: Domin asalin yana da jimloli 3, saboda haka ba zai yiwu a taƙaita shi ba.
l-e-h3-b03-04.s.s1.r.d: Ana iya taƙaita gajerun rubutu ma.
l-e-h3-b03-04.s.s1.explain: Sunan kyanwar ƙarin bayani ne, don haka ko da an cire shi daga taƙaitawa, babban saƙon (burodi yana ƙarewa da wuri, saboda haka suna toya sau biyu) yana nan.
l-e-h3-b03-04.s.s2.model.0: Jumlar sunan kyanwar ƙarin bayani ce, babban saƙon kuma yana nan idan aka cire ta, ma'ana ba a buƙatar kowace jumla.
l-e-h3-b03-04.s.s2.model.1: Babban saƙon shi ne burodin yana ƙarewa da wuri don haka suna toya sau biyu, ba sunan kyanwa ba, saboda haka da'awar ba daidai ba ce.

l-e-h3-b06-01.s.s1.explain: hard na nufin “mai ƙarfi, mai ƙwazo”, amma hardly na nufin “kusan ba”. Akwai haɗe-haɗe inda ƙara -ly ba ya barin ma’anar kusa.

l-e-h3-b01-07.material: Akwai jimlar da ke jera abubuwa, kamar “I like ___, ___, and ___.” Kana son gano ko abubuwan suna da tsari iri ɗaya (siffarsu ɗaya ce).

l-e-h3-b01-07.s.s1.o.a: Ko ma’anonin abubuwan suna kama da juna
l-e-h3-b01-07.s.s1.r.a: Ko da ma’anoni suna kama, ba su da tsari iri ɗaya idan siffofinsu sun bambanta.
l-e-h3-b01-07.s.s1.o.b: Ko abubuwan suna da yawan haruffa iri ɗaya
l-e-h3-b01-07.s.s1.r.b: Yawan haruffa ba shi da alaƙa da tsarin daidaito.
l-e-h3-b01-07.s.s1.o.c: Ko siffofin nahawun abubuwan iri ɗaya ne
l-e-h3-b01-07.s.s1.o.d: Ko abubuwan suna cikin jerin haruffa
l-e-h3-b01-07.s.s1.r.d: Jerin haruffa ba shi da alaƙa da tsarin daidaito.
l-e-h3-b01-07.s.s1.explain: Daidaitaccen tsari yana nufin siffofin nahawu na abubuwan (-ing, to-infinitive, da sauransu) iri ɗaya ne. Ma’ana da yawan haruffa ba su ne ma’aunin ba.
l-e-h3-b01-07.s.s2.model.0: Idan siffofin sun bambanta, kamar swimming da to hike, ba su da daidaitaccen tsari ko da ma’anoninsu suna kama; saboda haka dole ne a duba siffar nahawu.

l-e-h3-b01-08.material: Rubutu: “Rufin gine-gine da aka lullube da tsire-tsire yana sa gine-gine su fi sanyi a lokacin bazara. Haka kuma yana shanye ruwan sama, don haka ambaliyar ruwa a tituna tana raguwa. Wani rufi a Oslo ma yana da ƙaramin gidan ƙudan zuma.”
l-e-h3-b01-08.s.s1.prompt: Wane ma’auni ne za a yi amfani da shi wajen zaɓar bayanai yayin taƙaita wannan rubutu?
l-e-h3-b01-08.s.s1.o.a: Ko akwai sunan wani wuri a ciki
l-e-h3-b01-08.s.s1.r.a: Kasancewar sunan wuri a ciki ba ya sa ya zama babban ra’ayi.
l-e-h3-b01-08.s.s1.o.b: Ko shi ne babban ra’ayin rubutun da dalilinsa
l-e-h3-b01-08.s.s1.o.c: Ko yana cikin jimla mafi tsawo
l-e-h3-b01-08.s.s1.r.c: Tsawo ba shi da alaƙa da muhimmanci.
l-e-h3-b01-08.s.s1.o.d: Ko shi ne bayani mafi ban mamaki
l-e-h3-b01-08.s.s1.r.d: Gidan ƙudan zuma abin mamaki ne, amma ba shi ne babban ra’ayin ba.
l-e-h3-b01-08.s.s1.explain: Taƙaitawa tana ɗauke da babban ra’ayi (amfanin koren rufi), kuma ana iya barin ƙananan bayanai kamar gidan ƙudan zuma a Oslo.
l-e-h3-b01-08.s.s2.model.0: Babban batu shi ne cewa koren rufi yana sanyaya gine-gine kuma yana rage ambaliya, saboda haka za ka iya zaɓar bayanai bisa wannan ma’auni.
l-e-h3-b01-08.s.s2.model.1: Gidan ƙudan zuma ƙarin bayani ne, don haka ma’aunin saka babban ra’ayi da dalilinsa kaɗai shi ne ya dace da taƙaitawa.

l-e-h3-b01-09.s.s2.model.0: Batu ɗaya ne, amma kalmomin sun bambanta, kamar regret to inform da Heads up, saboda haka zaɓin kalmomi ne ke ƙayyade sautin.

l-e-h3-b01-10.goal: Zaɓi ma’auni (bayanin) da ake buƙata gaba ɗaya don gano kalmomin da suka dace idan aka haɗa su, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.

l-e-h3-b01-10.s.s1.prompt: Wane bayani ake buƙata gaba ɗaya don sanin ko kalmomi biyu sun dace idan aka haɗa su?
l-e-h3-b01-10.s.s1.o.a: Ko kalmomin suna da tsawo kuma suna da wahala
l-e-h3-b01-10.s.s1.r.a: Wahalar kalma ba ta da alaƙa da haɗa kalmomi.
l-e-h3-b01-10.s.s1.o.b: Ko ana yawan amfani da kalmomin biyu tare a zahiri
l-e-h3-b01-10.s.s1.o.c: Ko akwai irin wannan furuci a cikin harshen Koriya
l-e-h3-b01-10.s.s1.r.c: Ba za a iya amfani da harshen Koriya a matsayin ma’aunin haɗa kalmomin Turanci ba.
l-e-h3-b01-10.s.s1.o.d: Ko ma’anonin ƙamus na kalmomin biyu iri ɗaya ne
l-e-h3-b01-10.s.s1.r.d: Ko da ma’anarsu ɗaya ce, kalmomin da suka dace da su suna bambanta.
l-e-h3-b01-10.s.s1.explain: Ana ƙayyade haɗin kalmomi ta amfani da su na zahiri, ba ma’ana ba. Ka duba ko ana yawan amfani da su tare ta misalan jimlolin ƙamus ko wani tarin rubutu.
l-e-h3-b01-10.s.s2.model.0: A zahiri ana yawan amfani da heavy da rain tare, saboda haka amfani da kalmomin ne kawai zai nuna ko haɗinsu ya dace.
l-e-h3-b01-10.s.s2.model.1: Ko da ma’anonin sun yi kama, ba a amfani da strong rain, saboda haka ba za ka iya ganewa daga ma’anar ƙamus kaɗai ba; dole ne ka duba ko ana amfani da su tare.

l-e-h3-b02-06.goal: Ka gano bayanin da ake buƙata sosai don nemo preposition da ke zuwa bayan sifa, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-e-h3-b02-06.material: Kana son zaɓar preposition da ya dace don gurbin da ke cikin “I am interested ___ music.” Ka yanke shawarar wane bayani ake buƙata da gaske.

l-e-h3-b02-06.s.s1.o.b: Ko sunan music da ke bayansa yana da alaƙa da sauti

l-e-h3-b02-06.s.s1.r.c: Yawan mutane ba shi da alaƙa da preposition.

l-e-h3-b04-06.title: Ni irihe hame rituma tumenya itandukaniro rya make na do?
l-e-h3-b04-06.goal: Menya amakuru akenewe cyane kugira ngo hamenyekane niba imbere y'izina hakwiye make cyangwa do, hanyuma usobanure impamvu wayahisemo.
l-e-h3-b04-06.material: Make a mistake, do homework, make progress, do the dishes. Shaka itegeko rigena niba imbere y'izina hakwiye make cyangwa do.

l-e-h3-b04-06.s.s1.r.b: Umubare w'inyuguti ntushobora gutandukanya make na do.
l-e-h3-b04-06.s.s1.r.c: Amazina atari ibintu bifatika, nka make a mistake, na yo akoreshwa na make.
l-e-h3-b04-06.s.s1.o.d: Fi’ilin da aka kayyade da wannan suna
l-e-h3-b04-06.s.s1.explain: Kowane suna yana da fi’ilin da aka kayyade da shi, ‘make’ ko ‘do’. Dole ne a haddace su a matsayin haɗi, ba bisa ma’ana ko kamannin kalma ba.
l-e-h3-b04-06.s.s2.model.0: Kowane suna yana da takamaiman haɗi da ‘make’ ko ‘do’; saboda haka dole ne a san fi’ilin da ya dace da shi.

l-e-h3-b04-08.goal: Zaɓi wane ma’auni (bayani) ake buƙata matuƙa don gano ko abubuwan da aka jero sun dace da nahawu, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-e-h3-b04-08.material: ‘I like hiking, to swim, and biking.’ Kana son bincika ko abubuwan da aka jero suna daidai da nahawu.
l-e-h3-b04-08.s.s1.prompt: Me dole ne a kwatanta don bincika?
l-e-h3-b04-08.s.s1.r.a: Dole ne a duba siffar abubuwan, ba adadinsu ba.
l-e-h3-b04-08.s.s1.o.b: Ko abubuwan suna da siffa iri ɗaya (-ing da sauransu).
l-e-h3-b04-08.s.s1.r.c: Lokacin fi’ili da daidaita siffofin abubuwa daban-daban ne.
l-e-h3-b04-08.s.s1.o.d: Ko abubuwan da aka jero suna da kuskuren haruffa.
l-e-h3-b04-08.s.s1.r.d: Haruffan kalma da tsarin parallel matsaloli dabam-dabam ne.
l-e-h3-b04-08.s.s1.explain: Abubuwan da aka jero dole ne su kasance da siffa iri ɗaya. ‘Hiking’, ‘to swim’ da ‘biking’ suna da siffofi daban-daban; saboda haka ‘to swim’ ba ta cikin layi.
l-e-h3-b04-08.s.s2.model.0: Abubuwan dole ne su kasance da siffa iri ɗaya don zama parallel; saboda haka a kwatanta siffofinsu.
l-e-h3-b04-08.s.s2.model.1: Idan siffofin sun bambanta, kamar ‘hiking, to swim, and biking’, ba ya ji daɗi; ƙa’idar ita ce a duba ko siffofin iri ɗaya ne.

l-e-h3-b04-09.material: Akwai dogon rubutu da ke bayyana yadda ƙudan zuma ke ɗaukar furen fure tsakanin furannin amfanin gona. A tsakiya akwai dogon labari game da karen manomi. Yanke shawarar abin da za a saka a taƙaitawa.

l-e-h3-b02-14.s.s1.o.a: Taƙaitawa tana barin kalmar ƙarshe kawai.
l-e-h3-b02-14.s.s1.r.a: Abin da ya rage shi ne jimlar gama-gari da ke farko.
l-e-h3-b02-14.s.s1.o.b: Taƙaitawa tana cire misali, ta bar jimlar gama-gari.
l-e-h3-b02-14.s.s1.o.c: Taƙaitawa tana cire jimlar gama-gari, ta bar misali.
l-e-h3-b02-14.s.s1.r.c: Akasin haka ne: ana barin jimlar gama-gari.
l-e-h3-b02-14.s.s1.o.d: Taƙaitawa tana kwafa asalin rubutu yadda yake.
l-e-h3-b02-14.s.s1.r.d: Ba a saka misalin ba; saboda haka ba daidai yake da asalin ba.
l-e-h3-b02-14.s.s1.explain: An cire misalan da suka biyo bayan ‘for example’ da ‘for instance’, aka bar jimlar gama-gari da ke farko. Taƙaitawa tana mai da hankali ga jimlar gama-gari.

l-e-h3-b02-15.title: Ta yaya kalmomi ke sauya matakin tabbaci?
l-e-h3-b02-15.goal: Daga misalai da dama na yadda kalmomi ke sauya matakin tabbaci, gano ƙa’ida ka bayyana ta, sannan ka gwada ta da sabon misali.
l-e-h3-b02-15.material: ‘It will rain.’ / ‘It will probably rain.’ / ‘It might rain.’ / ‘I doubt it will rain.’ Gano ƙa’idar matakin tabbaci a jimlolin huɗun.
l-e-h3-b02-15.s.s1.o.a: ‘Will’ da ‘might’ suna nuna tabbaci iri ɗaya.
l-e-h3-b02-15.s.s1.o.b: Idan jimla ta fi tsawo, tabbaci ya fi yawa.
l-e-h3-b02-15.s.s1.r.b: Tsawon jimla ba shi da alaƙa da tabbaci.
l-e-h3-b02-15.s.s1.r.c: Tabbacin ya yi ƙasa da na ‘will’.
l-e-h3-b02-15.s.s1.o.d: Ƙara kalmomi kamar ‘probably’ ko ‘might’ yana rage tabbaci.
l-e-h3-b02-15.s.s1.explain: ‘Will’ yana nuna tabbaci, amfani da ‘probably’ ko ‘might’ kuma yana rage shi. ‘Doubt’ kuwa yana nuna yiwuwar ba zai faru ba.
l-e-h3-b02-15.s.s2.model.0: ‘Probably’ da ‘might’ suna rage tabbaci idan aka kwatanta da ‘will’; saboda haka kalmomi irin waɗannan alamu ne na ƙarancin tabbaci.
l-e-h3-b02-15.s.s2.model.1: ‘Will probably’ da ‘might’ suna nuna rashin tabbacin ko za a yi ruwa; saboda haka ƙa’idar ita ce tabbaci yana raguwa.

l-e-h3-b06-13.material: Uko dutangira kare, ni ko turangiza vuba. Uko ugerageza cyane, ni ko ukora neza. Shaka itegeko wuzuze: The more you practice, the ____ you become.
l-e-h3-b06-13.s.s1.r.a: Imbere harimo more, ariko igikurikiraho si imiterere yo kugereranya.
l-e-h3-b06-13.s.s1.r.c: Ni imiterere irenze byose, itandukanye n'itegeko ryo guhuza amagambo agereranya.
l-e-h3-b06-13.s.s1.r.d: Ni ingera, bityo ntishobora gukurikira become.
l-e-h3-b06-13.s.s1.explain: Mu ngero, amagambo yo kugereranya akurikira the mu bice byombi. Kubera ko confident ari ijambo rirerire, ni more confident.
l-e-h3-b06-13.s.s2.model.0: Mu ngero, ibice byombi bikoresha imiterere yo kugereranya, bityo ku ijambo rirerire confident, more confident ni ryo rikwiye.
l-e-h3-b06-13.s.s2.model.1: Itegeko ni ugukoresha imiterere yo kugereranya nyuma ya the more ..., bityo more confident ni yo ijyana na yo.

l-e-h3-b07-02.title: Wadanne kalmomi ne absolutely ke haɗuwa da su?
l-e-h3-b07-02.topic: Haɗuwa da siffofi masu tsananin ma'ana
l-e-h3-b07-02.goal: Daga misalai da yawa na siffofin da absolutely da very ke haɗuwa da su, bayyana ƙa'idar, sannan ka gwada ta da sabon misali.
l-e-h3-b07-02.material: Na halitta: very tired, very interesting, absolutely huge, absolutely exhausted. Baƙon abu: absolutely tired, absolutely interesting, very huge, very exhausted.
l-e-h3-b07-02.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi ƙa'idar da ke bayyana duk misalan da ke sama.
l-e-h3-b07-02.s.s1.o.a: Ana amfani da Absolutely ne kawai kafin siffofi masu dogon rubutu
l-e-h3-b07-02.s.s1.r.a: Ko da yake interesting doguwa ce, tana sautin baƙon abu da absolutely, alhali huge na halitta ce duk da gajeriyarta.
l-e-h3-b07-02.s.s1.o.b: Ba za a iya amfani da Very kafin kalmomin da suka ƙare da -ed ba
l-e-h3-b07-02.s.s1.r.b: very tired na halitta ne duk da cewa ya ƙare da -ed.
l-e-h3-b07-02.s.s1.o.c: Ana amfani da Absolutely ne kawai tare da ma'anoni marasa kyau
l-e-h3-b07-02.s.s1.r.c: Tired tana da ma'ana mara kyau, amma tana sautin baƙon abu tare da absolutely.
l-e-h3-b07-02.s.s1.o.d: Ana amfani da Absolutely tare da kalmomin da ma'anarsu ta riga ta zama mai tsanani
l-e-h3-b07-02.s.s1.explain: Huge da exhausted sun riga sun nuna tsananin ma'ana, saboda haka suna haɗuwa da absolutely. Tired da interesting suna haɗuwa da very, wanda ke daidaita matakin ma'anar.
l-e-h3-b07-02.s.s2.model.0: Ƙa'idar ita ce huge da exhausted sun riga sun nuna tsananin ma'ana, don haka ana amfani da su da absolutely, alhali tired da interesting ana amfani da su da very.
l-e-h3-b07-02.s.s2.model.1: Absolutely tired yana sautin baƙon abu domin tired ba shi da ma'ana mai tsanani, don haka ƙa'idar ta dogara ne da ko ma'anar tana da tsanani.

l-e-h3-b01-16.title: Kalmomi nawa ya kamata a ware wa kowane muhimmin batu?
l-e-h3-b01-16.goal: Yi kiyasin yawan kalmomin da za a yi amfani da su ga kowane muhimmin batu, zaɓi adadi ko iyaka mai dacewa, sannan ka bayyana dalilinka.
l-e-h3-b01-16.material: Taƙaitawa ba za ta wuce kalmomi 60 ba. Akwai muhimman batutuwa 5, kuma kana son rubuta kowanne da kusan tsawo ɗaya. Yi kiyasin kalmomin da za a yi amfani da su ga kowane batu.
l-e-h3-b01-16.s.s1.prompt: Wane adadin kalmomi ne ya fi dacewa ga kowane muhimmin batu?
l-e-h3-b01-16.s.s1.r.a: Idan akwai batutuwa 5, wannan kalmomi 25 ne, wanda bai kai kusa da cika iyakar ba.
l-e-h3-b01-16.s.s1.r.c: Idan akwai batutuwa 5, wannan ya zama kalmomi 150, wanda ya wuce iyakar.
l-e-h3-b01-16.s.s1.r.d: Idan akwai batutuwa 5, wannan ya zama kalmomi 300, wanda ya wuce iyakar.
l-e-h3-b01-16.s.s1.explain: 60 ÷ 5 = 12. Idan ka yi amfani da kusan kalmomi 12 ga kowane muhimmin batu, ba za ka wuce iyakar ba.
l-e-h3-b01-16.s.s2.model.0: 60 ÷ 5 = 12, saboda haka kowane muhimmin batu zai samu kusan kalmomi 12.
l-e-h3-b01-16.s.s2.model.1: Muhimman batutuwa 5 suna raba kalmomi 60, saboda haka 60÷5=12 kalmomi ko makamancin haka.

l-e-h3-b02-16.material: Rubutu yana da jimloli 8. Daga cikinsu, 3 misalai ne, 2 kuma suna maimaita abin da ya gabata. Yi kiyasin jimloli nawa ke ɗauke da sabon muhimmin bayani.

l-e-h3-b02-16.s.s1.explain: 8-3-2=3; saboda haka akwai kusan jimloli 3 masu sabon muhimmin bayani. A cire misalai da maimaitawa.
l-e-h3-b02-16.s.s2.model.0: Idan aka cire misalai 3 da maimaitawa 2 daga jimloli 8, jimloli 3 ne za su rage; saboda haka a bar kusan 3.
l-e-h3-b02-16.s.s2.model.1: Misalai da maimaitawa guda 5 ne; 8-5=3, wato kusan jimloli 3 ne masu muhimmin bayani.

l-e-h3-b01-28.s.s1.explain: Dole ne taƙaitawa ta ƙunshi babban batu (shagunan cika kwalabe) da dalilan (raguwar shara da farashi). Kada a ƙara abin da ba a cikin rubutun ba.

l-e-h3-b07-06.material: Jarida tana son amfani da jimloli masu tsaka-tsaki kawai. Mai rahoto P: Magajin gari ya amince da cewa gadar tana da aminci. Mai rahoto Q: Magajin gari ya ce gadar tana da aminci.

l-e-h3-b07-06.s.s1.r.c: Kowane fi'ilin bayar da rahoto yana ɗauke da ra'ayi dabam.

l-e-h3-b07-06.s.s2.model.0: Said yana isar da kalmomin magajin gari kawai, amma admitted yana ƙara hukuncin cewa magajin garin ya amince ne ba da son rai ba, don haka Q ne mai tsaka-tsaki.
